evals.name: author-table
evals.prompt: List authors in a sortable table using the generated AllAuthors query.
evals.expected_output: A DataPage in the Authors feature owns the query.
assertions: Imports AllAuthors from generated/Features/Authors/Listing/Author into Features/Authors/Listing/Authors.tsx.
Passes the query constructor, id dataKey and emptyMessage.
Declares a sortable name column under DataPage.Columns.

evals.name: open-author
evals.prompt: Open the selected author using an onOpen callback supplied by the page's caller.
evals.expected_output: A typed menu action passes a single selected author.
assertions: Checks single selection and a defined selectedItem before calling onOpen.

evals.name: async-action
evals.prompt: An asynchronous list action can fail while opening a selected author. Who should handle that failure?
evals.expected_output: The caller owns completion, failure and pending state.
assertions: Does not assume the menu awaits its command callback.
Handles rejected actions and repeated submissions in the caller.
Uses the selected author rather than a row index or display name.
